subject: Persona Switcher bundle with skills, agents, and prompts for multi-persona model-routed decision synthesis

skills.name: run-task-with-personas-and-models
skills.description: Use when you want the same task reviewed or answered by multiple predefined personas — each with a distinct role, experience level, and assigned model. Good for: comparing engineering vs product vs SRE perspectives on a decision; getting side-by-side proposals before choosing an implementation path; evaluating a tradeoff from junior, mid, and senior viewpoints; or any task where a single perspective isn't sufficient. Do not use to run a single-persona task or invoke one model directly — use the runner agents for that.
skills.argumentHint: Provide the task, optional decision to make, optional preset or persona subset, optional model overrides, constraints, success metrics, optional skill names and/or a skill reference/objective/mode, and the decision you want from the comparison.

agents.name: run-task-with-personas
agents.description: Persona Switcher orchestration agent. Resolve persona/model routes and shared skill context, run one isolated subagent per selected profile in parallel, and return a decision-ready synthesis.
agents.argumentHint: Provide task, optional decision to make, constraints, success metrics, optional preset/profile ids, optional model overrides, optional skill names and/or a skill reference/objective/mode, optional comparison goal, and optional response depth.

agents.name: persona-proposal-runner
agents.description: Generate one persona-specific recommendation for Persona Switcher from a provided profile, personaSource file, and optional shared skill context.

prompts.name: run-persona-switcher
prompts.description: Run Persona Switcher end-to-end for a single task using focused persona selection, predefined model routes, and optional skill context.
prompts.argumentHint: Provide task, optional decision to make, constraints, success metrics, optional preset/profile ids, optional model overrides, optional skill names and/or a skill reference/objective/mode, optional comparison goal, and optional response depth.

prompts.name: run-persona-switcher-quick
prompts.description: Run Persona Switcher in quick mode with focused auto-selection, speed-first comparison, and concise output.
prompts.argumentHint: Provide task and optional constraints; quick mode defaults to preset `auto`, comparison goal `speed-first`, and response depth `brief` unless you override them, and it also accepts optional skill names and/or a skill reference/objective/mode.
